ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity (white) central region across both lobes; continuous low-intensity (black) perimeter banding along the trailing edges; vertical low-intensity striations extending from the median notch; irregular low-intensity splotches concentrated on the distal leading edges and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary; right lobe (viewer perspective) displays high-amplitude serrations with 4-5 prominent peaks; left lobe displays lower-amplitude, higher-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the leading edges towards the distal tips; moderate convexity along the trailing edge lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters (dark-on-white) representing barnacle attachment scars, primarily localized in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity central surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular erosion on the trailing edge of the right lobe lobe; multiple circular pitted scars across central white regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, high-intensity white calcified deposits (live barnacles) visible at the distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
